title: Awake: Hello Windows Facial Recognition Not Working After Screen Turns Off

status.label: Reporter requested closure
status.detail: The reporter can no longer reproduce reliably and explicitly asked to close the ticket.

next_action.label: Honor reporter disposition
next_action.reason: There is no current reproducible PowerToys-specific failure to design against.

judgment.rationale: The reporter's October 12 reply explicitly requests closure because reliable reproduction is no longer possible. The earlier diagnostic request is obsolete; an Awake root cause was never established.
evidence: The original report supplies PowerToys 0.100.2, Windows 11 25H2 build 26200.8894, indefinite Awake mode, and a diagnostic archive.
A maintainer asked whether Hello also fails with Awake disabled and Windows configured to keep the PC awake while turning the display off.
https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/49545#issuecomment-6116733757 says the issue cannot now be reproduced reliably and asks for closure.
The issue is still OPEN; no closure was performed during this pass.
judgment.recommended_action: Treat the report as reporter-withdrawn and remove fix/evidence actions; a maintainer can handle closure separately.

fix_assessment.rationale: There is no longer a reproducible scoped bug to fix, and the Awake-versus-Windows/camera ownership discriminator was not established.

issue_context.summary: A Windows Hello failure was reported while Awake kept the PC running, but the reporter now asks to close the issue because it cannot be reproduced reliably.
known_information: The original report includes the affected mode, exact OS build, and a diagnostic ZIP.
The maintainer proposed an Awake-disabled display-off/no-sleep control.
The reporter withdrew the report instead of supplying a reproducible control comparison.
inferences: The original correlation with Awake is not sufficient to establish a PowerToys, camera-driver, or Windows Hello root cause.
issue_context.analysis: The latest author response changes the appropriate disposition. Repeating the previous generic diagnostic request would ignore that response.
initial_investigation: Read the complete body and both comments, omitting email-quoted notification details from this public synthesis.
Checked live open state, labels, empty assignees, and linked-work timeline.
